Then she went inside, found paper and a pen, and began to write back.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有完全睡着。路灯将湿漉漉的街道染成橘黄色，偶尔有一辆出租车滑过，车灯在积水里拉出长长的倒影。便利店的玻璃门透出冷白的光，收银员靠在柜台上，眼神空洞地盯着屏幕。远处的高架桥上，一辆货车轰鸣而过，声音在楼宇间回荡，片刻后归于寂静。早点摊的老板已经起身，炉火刚刚点燃，热气在冷空气中升腾。城市像一个将醒未醒的人，呼吸绵长而沉重，等待第一缕天光将它重新唤回人间。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something is defined in terms of itself — like a dream inside a dream.\n• Imagine you want to know how many people are in a line ahead of you: you ask the person in front, who asks the person in front of them, and so on until someone at the front says zero; then each person adds one and passes the answer back.\n• Every recursive process needs a stopping point — called the base case — otherwise it would go on forever, just like you'd never get your answer if the line had no end."}
